baseline_rationale: Chikungunya is primarily transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, which are present in some EU/EEA countries. However, the overall incidence of locally acquired cases has been low in recent years, and public health measures are in place to control outbreaks. Given the historical data and current trends, it is reasonable to predict that the majority of countries will not report any cases, with a small chance of 1 country reporting a case, and a decreasing likelihood for higher numbers of cases.
